info.title: Portal Guanabara API
info.description: Contract between the Portal Guanabara web app and its backend. Today the Catalog paths are served by the web app's own server routes (Nitro) from the published snapshot; the target is a Spring Boot service in BVRio's core-bvrio over MySQL (docs/architecture/backend.md). Operations marked PROPOSED (x-status: proposed) are not implemented yet. The read schemas are checked against the server's real responses by `src/contracts/openapi.tests.ts`.

servers.description: Same origin (CloudFront routes /api/* to the backend).

post.summary: PROPOSED — suggest a new entry or a correction (public, no login)
post.description: Rate-limited and protected by a captcha. Nothing is published until an editor approves it.

post.summary: PROPOSED — approve (creates or changes the entry) or reject a suggestion

delete.summary: PROPOSED — retire an entry (its ID is never reused, D-047)

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Language of the controlled vocabularies (keywords, sectors, mechanisms, types). pt-BR (default), en, es or fr. Free text and proper names stay in Portuguese.

staff.description: PROPOSED. Editors only (BVRio staff), e.g. BVRio's Keycloak validated by Spring's OAuth2 resource server. The public site has no login.

EntryStatus.description: Projects: active, in_implementation, ended. Studies: published, in_progress.

date.description: ISO date; missing parts filled with 01.

PartialDate.description: A date known only as precisely as the source says (D-033).

label.description: In the language of Accept-Language for controlled vocabularies; proper names stay as they are.

Bucket.description: A category and how many entries it reaches.

KindBucket.description: A bucket split by kind (v0.8): count = projects + studies.

distributions.description: Sorted by count, then name. Unknown values are never a bucket (D-032).

unknown.description: Entries with no confirmed value for the dimension.

ListQuery.description: The query as the server understood it: unknown values dropped, defaults applied.

facets.description: Options per filter, counted against every other active filter.

code.description: Institution filter code (slug), as in ?institution=; null for people (v0.9).

personsHidden.description: True when person names exist but were left out (LGPD flag).

code.description: Slug — the value of the entry list's `institution` filter.

allKinds.description: Institutions matching every other filter, whatever the kind (the "Todos" count of the kind toggle).

MultiPolygon.description: GeoJSON MultiPolygon coordinates (WGS 84 longitude, latitude): polygons → rings → positions.

geometry.description: Provisional zone in the water; null for sectors that are not one area (Baía inteira).

label.description: Where the map writes the name and counts (longitude, latitude).

municipalities.description: With entries first (by count, then name), then the neighbours drawn for context.

sectors.description: Every bay sector of the catalog, from the bay's head to the open sea (v0.8).

SubmissionRequest.description: PROPOSED. A public suggestion: a new entry, or a correction to one (`ref`). Reviewed by editors before anything is published.

entry.description: The proposed fields, same names as EntryDetails (free text in Portuguese). Validated by the editors, not trusted.

contact.description: Only to follow up on the suggestion; never published; deleted after the retention period (LGPD).

EntryWrite.description: PROPOSED. An entry as editors create or change it (same fields as EntryDetails, codes for vocabularies, places and parties).
